title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Entertainment
desc: Akhil, a down-on-his-luck man, learns his real father was a wealthy diamond merchant. But when he seeks his inheritance, he is shocked to find it has been left to a dog.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagement to Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan engaged to wealthy Prem, suffers first-degree burns in a house fire just days before their wedding, testing love, resilience, and family bonds.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Arjun Son Of Vyjayanthi
desc: In Order To Protect The People Of His Village, A Man Becomes A Ruthless Vigilante Against His Police Officer Mother'S Wishes.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: Dil Dhadakne Do
desc: Kamal and Neelam celebrate their 30th anniversary on a cruise, where family, friends, and unexpected lessons transform their lives and relationships forever.

title: Mera Gaon Mera Desh
desc: A reformed man bravely opposes a ruthless village tyrant, but when his beloved is kidnapped, the confrontation turns personal, forcing a fierce battle for justice.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
